name: globe
title: Network Globe
description: Interactive dotted world globe with animated routes, location navigation, and a desktop flat-map projection.

props.name: autoConnect
props.label: Automatic Routes
props.description: Periodically animates a route between two random locations.

props.name: autoRotate
props.label: Auto Rotate
props.description: Continuously rotates the globe when it is idle.

props.name: rotationSpeed
props.label: Rotation Speed
props.description: Automatic globe rotation speed in degrees per second.

props.name: routeFrequency
props.label: Route Frequency
props.description: Delay in seconds between automatic route animations.

props.name: routeDuration
props.label: Route Duration
props.description: Duration of each animated route in seconds.

props.name: connections
props.label: Connections
props.description: Number of nearby routes emitted after selecting a location.

props.name: dotDensity
props.label: Dot Density
props.description: Number of sphere samples used to build the dotted land field.

props.name: dotSize
props.label: Dot Size
props.description: Rendered diameter of each land dot in pixels.

props.name: markerSize
props.label: Marker Size
props.description: Rendered diameter of each location marker in pixels.

props.name: mapColor
props.label: Map Color
props.description: Color of the dotted land field.

props.name: markerColor
props.label: Marker Color
props.description: Color of location markers and the globe outline.

props.name: showLabels
props.label: Show Labels
props.description: Shows location labels around the globe.

props.name: enableDrag
props.label: Enable Drag
props.description: Allows pointer dragging to rotate the globe.

props.name: morphDuration
props.label: Morph Duration
props.description: Duration of the globe-to-map projection transition in seconds.
